messages: Step 1 per the skill: run `compagnon status --json`.

This project has no `_compagnon/`. Run `compagnon init` first, then come back to `/compagnon-configure`.

`compagnon status --json` returned `no_compagnon_root`, and there's no `_compagnon/config.yaml` in the repo. The skill only enriches an existing config and never creates one, so it stopped here. Nothing was read past that check and nothing was written. Because it stopped before the proposal step, it never got to the confirmation question.
